93	def get_layer_groups(model):
94	    """Group vision backbone parameters by encoder block."""
95	    groups = OrderedDict()
96	    for name, param in model.vision_backbone.named_parameters():
97	        parts = name.split(".")
98	        if "blocks" in parts:
99	            idx = parts.index("blocks")
100	            group = ".".join(parts[:idx + 2])
101	        else:
102	            prefix = parts[0] if parts[0] in ("featurizer", "fused_featurizer") else "other"
103	            group = prefix + ".stem"
104	        if group not in groups:

110	def compute_per_layer_grads(grads, layer_groups):
111	    """Compute L2 norm and flattened gradient vector per layer group."""
112	    norms = {}
113	    vectors = {}
114	    idx = 0
115	    for group_name, params in layer_groups.items():
116	        parts = []
117	        for _ in params:
118	            g = grads[idx]
119	            if g is not None:
120	                parts.append(g.flatten().float())
121	            idx += 1
122	        if parts:
123	            vec = torch.cat(parts)
124	            norms[group_name] = vec.norm().item()
125	            vectors[group_name] = vec
126	        else:
127	            norms[group_name] = 0.0
128	            vectors[group_name] = None
129	    return norms, vectors

145	                "weight": module.weight.data.cpu().tolist(),

148	                "var_drift_from_one_l2": (module.running_var.float() - 1.0).norm().item(),

"""
Same-seed gradient analysis for OccSafe-VLA 4-condition ablation (seed=42).

Runs one condition at a time. Each run produces a JSON with per-layer gradient
stats and BN drift data. Use plot_gradient_comparison.py to compare results.

Usage:
  # Full OCC + BN
  python same_seed_gradient_analysis.py \
    --checkpoint_path /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/ablation_occ_s0/.../50000_chkpt \
    --condition_name full_occ_bn \
    --occ_detach false --occ_norm bn \
    --output_dir /root/occsafe_vla/analysis/same_seed_results

  # Detach + BN
  python same_seed_gradient_analysis.py \
    --checkpoint_path /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/ablation_occ_detach_s0_retrain/.../50000_chkpt \
    --condition_name detach_bn \
    --occ_detach true --occ_norm bn \
    --output_dir /root/occsafe_vla/analysis/same_seed_results

  # Full OCC + LN
  python same_seed_gradient_analysis.py \
    --checkpoint_path /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/full_occ_ln_s0/.../50000_chkpt \
    --condition_name full_occ_ln \
    --occ_detach false --occ_norm ln \
    --output_dir /root/occsafe_vla/analysis/same_seed_results

  # Detach + LN
  python same_seed_gradient_analysis.py \
    --checkpoint_path /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/detach_ln_s0/.../50000_chkpt \
    --condition_name detach_ln \
    --occ_detach true --occ_norm ln \
    --output_dir /root/occsafe_vla/analysis/same_seed_results

Env: conda activate occsafe, Python 3.10+, PyTorch 2.x
Server: /root/occsafe_vla/openvla-oft

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
import time
from collections import OrderedDict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader

sys.path.insert(0, "/root/occsafe_vla/openvla-oft")

from transformers import AutoModelForVision2Seq, AutoProcessor
from prismatic.models.occ_head import BEVOccupancyHead, FocalLoss
from prismatic.models.action_heads import L1RegressionActionHead
from prismatic.models.backbones.llm.prompting import PurePromptBuilder
from prismatic.vla.action_tokenizer import ActionTokenizer
from prismatic.vla.constants import ACTION_DIM, NUM_ACTIONS_CHUNK
from prismatic.vla.datasets import RLDSBatchTransform, RLDSDataset
from prismatic.util.data_utils import PaddedCollatorForActionPrediction
from prismatic.training.train_utils import get_current_action_mask, get_next_actions_mask


def parse_args():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Same-seed gradient analysis for OccSafe-VLA")
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint_path", type=str, required=True,
                        help="Path to merged checkpoint directory (with action_head, occ_head)")
    parser.add_argument("--condition_name", type=str, required=True,
                        help="Condition label: full_occ_bn / detach_bn / full_occ_ln / detach_ln")
    parser.add_argument("--occ_detach", type=str, default="false",
                        help="Whether occ gradients are detached from backbone")
    parser.add_argument("--occ_norm", type=str, choices=["bn", "ln"], default="bn",
                        help="OCC head norm type: bn (BatchNorm) or ln (GroupNorm-1)")
    parser.add_argument("--data_root", type=str,
                        default="/root/autodl-tmp/data/modified_libero_rlds",
                        help="Root directory of RLDS datasets")
    parser.add_argument("--dataset_name", type=str, default="libero_spatial_no_noops")
    parser.add_argument("--occ_data_dir", type=str,
                        default="/root/occsafe_vla/occ_data",
                        help="Path to BEV occupancy label HDF5 files")
    parser.add_argument("--num_batches", type=int, default=200,
                        help="Number of validation batches to process")
    parser.add_argument("--batch_size", type=int, default=4)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42,
                        help="Random seed for data sampling (must match across conditions)")
    parser.add_argument("--gpu", type=int, default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--output_dir", type=str, required=True)
    return parser.parse_args()


def get_layer_groups(model):
    """Group vision backbone parameters by encoder block."""
    groups = OrderedDict()
    for name, param in model.vision_backbone.named_parameters():
        parts = name.split(".")
        if "blocks" in parts:
            idx = parts.index("blocks")
            group = ".".join(parts[:idx + 2])
        else:
            prefix = parts[0] if parts[0] in ("featurizer", "fused_featurizer") else "other"
            group = prefix + ".stem"
        if group not in groups:
            groups[group] = []
        groups[group].append(param)
    return groups


def compute_per_layer_grads(grads, layer_groups):
    """Compute L2 norm and flattened gradient vector per layer group."""
    norms = {}
    vectors = {}
    idx = 0
    for group_name, params in layer_groups.items():
        parts = []
        for _ in params:
            g = grads[idx]
            if g is not None:
                parts.append(g.flatten().float())
            idx += 1
        if parts:
            vec = torch.cat(parts)
            norms[group_name] = vec.norm().item()
            vectors[group_name] = vec
        else:
            norms[group_name] = 0.0
            vectors[group_name] = None
    return norms, vectors


def extract_bn_stats(occ_head):
    """Extract BatchNorm running statistics from the occ head.

    Returns dict with layer_name -> {running_mean, running_var, num_batches_tracked}.
    Only applicable when occ_head uses BatchNorm2d (norm_type='bn').
    """
    bn_stats = {}
    for name, module in occ_head.named_modules():
        if isinstance(module, nn.BatchNorm2d):
            bn_stats[name] = {
                "running_mean": module.running_mean.cpu().tolist(),
                "running_var": module.running_var.cpu().tolist(),
                "num_batches_tracked": module.num_batches_tracked.item(),
                "weight": module.weight.data.cpu().tolist(),
                "bias": module.bias.data.cpu().tolist(),
                "mean_drift_l2": module.running_mean.float().norm().item(),
                "var_drift_from_one_l2": (module.running_var.float() - 1.0).norm().item(),
            }
    return bn_stats


def main():
    args = parse_args()
    occ_detach = args.occ_detach.lower() in ("true", "1", "yes")
    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{args.gpu}")
    os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)

    # Fix seed for reproducible data sampling across conditions
    torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
    np.random.seed(args.seed)

    print(f"=== Same-Seed Gradient Analysis: {args.condition_name} ===")
    print(f"Checkpoint: {args.checkpoint_path}")
    print(f"OCC detach={occ_detach}, norm={args.occ_norm}, seed={args.seed}")
    print(f"Device: {device}")

    # ---- Load model ----
    print("\nLoading model...")
    vla = AutoModelForVision2Seq.from_pretrained(
        args.checkpoint_path, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
        low_cpu_mem_usage=True, trust_remote_code=True,
    )
    vla = vla.to(device)
    vla.eval()

    for p in vla.parameters():
        p.requires_grad_(False)
    for p in vla.vision_backbone.parameters():
        p.requires_grad_(True)

    processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(args.checkpoint_path, trust_remote_code=True)

    vision_embed_dim = vla.vision_backbone.embed_dim
    llm_dim = vla.config.text_config.hidden_size
    num_patches = vla.vision_backbone.get_num_patches()
    num_images = vla.vision_backbone.get_num_images_in_input()
    NUM_PATCHES_TOTAL = num_patches * num_images

    print(f"Vision embed_dim={vision_embed_dim}, LLM dim={llm_dim}")
    print(f"Patches={num_patches}, images={num_images}, total={NUM_PATCHES_TOTAL}")

    # ---- Load action head ----
    action_head = L1RegressionActionHead(
        input_dim=llm_dim, hidden_dim=llm_dim, action_dim=ACTION_DIM,
    ).to(torch.bfloat16).to(device)
    ah_ckpts = sorted(Path(args.checkpoint_path).glob("action_head--*.pt"))
    if ah_ckpts:
        sd = torch.load(ah_ckpts[0], map_location=device, weights_only=False)
        sd = {k.replace("module.", ""): v for k, v in sd.items()}
        action_head.load_state_dict(sd)
        print(f"Loaded action head: {ah_ckpts[0].name}")
    action_head.eval()
    for p in action_head.parameters():
        p.requires_grad_(False)

    # ---- Load occ head ----
    occ_head = BEVOccupancyHead(
        in_dim=vision_embed_dim, out_resolution=64,
        num_classes=1, num_patches_per_image=num_patches, norm_type=args.occ_norm,
    ).to(torch.bfloat16).to(device)
    oh_ckpts = sorted(Path(args.checkpoint_path).glob("occ_head--*.pt"))
    if oh_ckpts:
        sd = torch.load(oh_ckpts[0], map_location=device, weights_only=False)
        sd = {k.replace("module.", ""): v for k, v in sd.items()}
        occ_head.load_state_dict(sd)
        print(f"Loaded occ head: {oh_ckpts[0].name}")
    else:
        print("WARNING: No occ_head checkpoint found, using random init")
    occ_head.eval()
    for p in occ_head.parameters():
        p.requires_grad_(False)

    occ_loss_fn = FocalLoss().to(device)

    # ---- Extract BN stats before analysis ----
    bn_drift = extract_bn_stats(occ_head)
    if bn_drift:
        print(f"\nBN layers found: {len(bn_drift)}")
        for name, stats in bn_drift.items():
            print(f"  {name}: mean_drift_L2={stats['mean_drift_l2']:.4f}, "
                  f"var_drift_L2={stats['var_drift_from_one_l2']:.4f}, "
                  f"tracked={stats['num_batches_tracked']}")
    else:
        print("\nNo BatchNorm layers (norm_type=ln uses GroupNorm)")

    # ---- Data pipeline ----
    print("\nSetting up data pipeline...")
    action_tokenizer = ActionTokenizer(processor.tokenizer)
    batch_transform = RLDSBatchTransform(
        action_tokenizer,
        processor.tokenizer,
        image_transform=processor.image_processor.apply_transform,
        prompt_builder_fn=PurePromptBuilder,
        occ_data_dir=args.occ_data_dir,
        occ_resolution=64,
    )
    dataset = RLDSDataset(
        args.data_root, args.dataset_name, batch_transform,
        resize_resolution=tuple(vla.config.image_sizes),
        shuffle_buffer_size=10000, image_aug=False,
    )
    collator = PaddedCollatorForActionPrediction(
        processor.tokenizer.model_max_length,
        processor.tokenizer.pad_token_id,
        padding_side="right",
    )
    dataloader = DataLoader(
        dataset, batch_size=args.batch_size,
        collate_fn=collator, num_workers=0,
    )

    # ---- Layer groups ----
    layer_groups = get_layer_groups(vla)
    all_params = []
    for params in layer_groups.values():
        all_params.extend(params)
    layer_names = list(layer_groups.keys())
    n_params = sum(p.numel() for p in all_params)
    print(f"Tracking {n_params:,} parameters in {len(layer_groups)} groups")

    # ---- Storage ----
    all_action_norms = {g: [] for g in layer_names}
    all_occ_norms = {g: [] for g in layer_names}
    all_cosine = {g: [] for g in layer_names}
    batch_stats = []

    # ---- Main loop ----
    print(f"\nStarting gradient analysis ({args.num_batches} batches, bs={args.batch_size})...\n")
    t0 = time.time()

    for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(dataloader):
        if batch_idx >= args.num_batches:
            break

        try:
            # Forward pass
            with torch.amp.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16):
                output = vla(
                    input_ids=batch["input_ids"].to(device),
                    attention_mask=batch["attention_mask"].to(device),
                    pixel_values=batch["pixel_values"].to(torch.bfloat16).to(device),
                    labels=batch["labels"].to(device),
                    output_hidden_states=True,
                )

            # ---- Action loss ----
            last_hidden = output.hidden_states[-1]
            text_hidden = last_hidden[:, NUM_PATCHES_TOTAL:-1]
            gt_token_ids = batch["labels"][:, 1:].to(device)
            cur_mask = get_current_action_mask(gt_token_ids)
            nxt_mask = get_next_actions_mask(gt_token_ids)
            all_mask = cur_mask | nxt_mask

            bs = batch["input_ids"].shape[0]
            actions_hidden = (
                text_hidden[all_mask]
                .reshape(bs, NUM_ACTIONS_CHUNK * ACTION_DIM, -1)
                .to(torch.bfloat16)
            )
            gt_actions = batch["actions"].to(device).to(torch.bfloat16)
            pred_actions = action_head.predict_action(actions_hidden)
            action_loss = nn.L1Loss()(gt_actions, pred_actions)

            # ---- OCC loss ----
            patch_features = vla._cached_patch_features
            pf = patch_features.detach() if occ_detach else patch_features
            occ_logits = occ_head(pf.to(torch.bfloat16))
            occ_targets = batch["occ_labels"].to(device).float()
            occ_loss = occ_loss_fn(occ_logits.float(), occ_targets)

            # ---- Action gradients ----
            action_grads = torch.autograd.grad(
                action_loss.float(), all_params,
                retain_graph=(not occ_detach), allow_unused=True,
            )
            action_norms, action_vecs = compute_per_layer_grads(action_grads, layer_groups)

            # ---- OCC gradients (only for non-detach conditions) ----
            occ_norms = {}
            cosines = {}
            if not occ_detach:
                try:
                    occ_grads = torch.autograd.grad(
                        occ_loss.float(), all_params,
                        retain_graph=False, allow_unused=True,
                    )
                    occ_norms, occ_vecs = compute_per_layer_grads(occ_grads, layer_groups)
                    for g in layer_names:
                        av, ov = action_vecs.get(g), occ_vecs.get(g)
                        if av is not None and ov is not None:
                            cosines[g] = nn.functional.cosine_similarity(
                                av.unsqueeze(0), ov.unsqueeze(0),
                            ).item()
                        else:
                            cosines[g] = float("nan")
                except RuntimeError as e:
                    print(f"  [batch {batch_idx}] occ grad error: {e}")
                    for g in layer_names:
                        occ_norms[g] = 0.0
                        cosines[g] = float("nan")
            else:
                for g in layer_names:
                    occ_norms[g] = 0.0
                    cosines[g] = float("nan")

            # ---- Record ----
            batch_stats.append({
                "batch_idx": batch_idx,
                "action_loss": action_loss.item(),
                "occ_loss": occ_loss.item(),
            })
            for g in layer_names:
                all_action_norms[g].append(action_norms.get(g, 0))
                all_occ_norms[g].append(occ_norms.get(g, 0))
                all_cosine[g].append(cosines.get(g, float("nan")))

            if batch_idx % 10 == 0:
                elapsed = time.time() - t0
                avg_an = np.mean(list(action_norms.values()))
                mem = torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(device) / 1e9
                print(f"  [{batch_idx:>4d}/{args.num_batches}] "
                      f"act={action_loss.item():.4f} occ={occ_loss.item():.4f} "
                      f"avg_grad={avg_an:.6f} mem={mem:.1f}GB t={elapsed:.0f}s")

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  [batch {batch_idx}] ERROR: {e}")
            import traceback; traceback.print_exc()
            continue

    total_batches = len(batch_stats)
    total_time = time.time() - t0
    print(f"\nCompleted {total_batches} batches in {total_time:.0f}s ({total_time/60:.1f} min)")

    # ---- Aggregate ----
    summary = {
        "condition": args.condition_name,
        "occ_detach": occ_detach,
        "occ_norm": args.occ_norm,
        "seed": args.seed,
        "checkpoint_path": args.checkpoint_path,
        "num_batches": total_batches,
        "batch_size": args.batch_size,
        "avg_action_loss": float(np.mean([b["action_loss"] for b in batch_stats])),
        "avg_occ_loss": float(np.mean([b["occ_loss"] for b in batch_stats])),
        "total_time_sec": total_time,
        "bn_drift": bn_drift,
        "per_layer": {},
    }

    for g in layer_names:
        an = all_action_norms[g]
        on = all_occ_norms[g]
        cs = [c for c in all_cosine[g] if not np.isnan(c)]
        summary["per_layer"][g] = {
            "action_grad_norm_mean": float(np.mean(an)),
            "action_grad_norm_std": float(np.std(an)),
            "occ_grad_norm_mean": float(np.mean(on)),
            "occ_grad_norm_std": float(np.std(on)),
            "cosine_sim_mean": float(np.mean(cs)) if cs else None,
            "cosine_sim_std": float(np.std(cs)) if cs else None,
            "conflict_rate": float(sum(1 for c in cs if c < 0) / len(cs)) if cs else None,
        }

    # ---- Save ----
    out_json = os.path.join(args.output_dir, f"{args.condition_name}_gradient_stats.json")
    with open(out_json, "w") as f:
        json.dump(summary, f, indent=2)
    print(f"Saved summary: {out_json}")

    raw_json = os.path.join(args.output_dir, f"{args.condition_name}_gradient_raw.json")
    raw = {
        "batch_stats": batch_stats,
        "action_norms": dict(all_action_norms),
        "occ_norms": dict(all_occ_norms),
        "cosine_sims": {g: [x if not np.isnan(x) else None for x in v]
                        for g, v in all_cosine.items()},
    }
    with open(raw_json, "w") as f:
        json.dump(raw, f, indent=2)
    print(f"Saved raw data: {raw_json}")

    # ---- Summary table ----
    print(f"\n{'='*80}")
    print(f"SUMMARY: {args.condition_name} (detach={occ_detach}, norm={args.occ_norm})")
    print(f"{'='*80}")
    print(f"Avg action loss: {summary['avg_action_loss']:.4f}")
    print(f"Avg occ loss:    {summary['avg_occ_loss']:.4f}")
    print(f"\n{'Layer':<35s} {'ActGrad':>10s} {'OccGrad':>10s} {'Cosine':>10s} {'Conflict':>10s}")
    print("-" * 80)
    for g in layer_names:
        s = summary["per_layer"][g]
        cos_str = f"{s['cosine_sim_mean']:.4f}" if s["cosine_sim_mean"] is not None else "N/A"
        conf_str = f"{s['conflict_rate']:.2%}" if s["conflict_rate"] is not None else "N/A"
        print(f"{g:<35s} {s['action_grad_norm_mean']:>10.6f} {s['occ_grad_norm_mean']:>10.6f} "
              f"{cos_str:>10s} {conf_str:>10s}")
    print(f"{'='*80}")

    if bn_drift:
        print(f"\nBN Running Stats Drift (from init: mean=0, var=1):")
        for name, stats in bn_drift.items():
            print(f"  {name}: mean_drift_L2={stats['mean_drift_l2']:.4f}, "
                  f"var_drift_L2={stats['var_drift_from_one_l2']:.4f}")

    print(f"\nDone. Results saved to {args.output_dir}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
4-condition same-seed gradient comparison plots for OccSafe-VLA.

Reads JSON outputs from same_seed_gradient_analysis.py and produces
publication-quality comparison figures.

Usage:
  python plot_gradient_comparison.py \
    --results_dir /root/occsafe_vla/analysis/same_seed_results \
    --output_dir /root/occsafe_vla/analysis/same_seed_results/figures

  # Or specify individual files:
  python plot_gradient_comparison.py \
    --files full_occ_bn_gradient_stats.json detach_bn_gradient_stats.json \
            full_occ_ln_gradient_stats.json detach_ln_gradient_stats.json \
    --output_dir ./figures

Env: conda activate occsafe
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.gridspec import GridSpec
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker


CONDITION_STYLES = {
    "full_occ_bn":  {"color": "#2196F3", "marker": "o", "ls": "-",  "label": "Full OCC + BN"},
    "detach_bn":    {"color": "#F44336", "marker": "s", "ls": "--", "label": "Detach + BN"},
    "full_occ_ln":  {"color": "#4CAF50", "marker": "^", "ls": "-",  "label": "Full OCC + LN"},
    "detach_ln":    {"color": "#FF9800", "marker": "D", "ls": "--", "label": "Detach + LN"},
}

BACKBONE_PREFIXES = {
    "featurizer": "DINOv2",
    "fused_featurizer": "SigLIP",
}


def parse_args():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--results_dir", type=str, default=None,
                        help="Directory with *_gradient_stats.json files")
    parser.add_argument("--files", nargs="+", default=None,
                        help="Explicit list of JSON stat files")
    parser.add_argument("--output_dir", type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--dpi", type=int, default=300)
    return parser.parse_args()


def load_results(args):
    if args.files:
        paths = [Path(f) for f in args.files]
    elif args.results_dir:
        paths = sorted(Path(args.results_dir).glob("*_gradient_stats.json"))
    else:
        raise ValueError("Must specify --results_dir or --files")

    results = {}
    for p in paths:
        with open(p) as f:
            data = json.load(f)
        cond = data["condition"]
        results[cond] = data
        print(f"Loaded {cond}: {p.name}")
    return results


def extract_blocks(per_layer, prefix):
    blocks = []
    for layer_name, stats in per_layer.items():
        if layer_name.startswith(f"{prefix}.blocks."):
            idx = int(layer_name.split(".")[-1])
            blocks.append((idx, stats))
    blocks.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    return blocks


def setup_style():
    plt.rcParams.update({
        "font.family": "serif",
        "font.serif": ["Times New Roman", "DejaVu Serif"],
        "font.size": 10,
        "axes.labelsize": 11,
        "axes.titlesize": 12,
        "legend.fontsize": 9,
        "xtick.labelsize": 9,
        "ytick.labelsize": 9,
        "figure.dpi": 150,
        "savefig.dpi": 300,
        "savefig.bbox": "tight",
        "axes.grid": True,
        "grid.alpha": 0.3,
        "grid.linewidth": 0.5,
    })


def get_style(cond):
    if cond in CONDITION_STYLES:
        return CONDITION_STYLES[cond]
    return {"color": "gray", "marker": "x", "ls": "-", "label": cond}


def plot_action_gradient_norms(results, output_dir, dpi):
    """Fig 1: Per-layer action gradient norms across 4 conditions, split by backbone."""
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 4.5), sharey=True)

    for i, (prefix, backbone_name) in enumerate(BACKBONE_PREFIXES.items()):
        ax = axes[i]
        for cond, data in results.items():
            style = get_style(cond)
            blocks = extract_blocks(data["per_layer"], prefix)
            if not blocks:
                continue
            xs = [b[0] for b in blocks]
            ys = [b[1]["action_grad_norm_mean"] for b in blocks]
            ax.plot(xs, ys, marker=style["marker"], ls=style["ls"],
                    color=style["color"], label=style["label"],
                    markersize=4, linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.85)

        ax.set_xlabel("Block Index")
        ax.set_ylabel("Action Gradient L2 Norm" if i == 0 else "")
        ax.set_title(f"{backbone_name}")
        ax.set_yscale("log")
        ax.legend(loc="best", framealpha=0.9)

    fig.suptitle("Action Gradient Norms per Block (Same Seed)", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", y=1.02)
    plt.tight_layout()
    for ext in ("pdf", "png"):
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(output_dir, f"action_gradient_norms.{ext}"), dpi=dpi)
    plt.close(fig)
    print("Saved: action_gradient_norms.pdf/png")


def plot_occ_gradient_norms(results, output_dir, dpi):
    """Fig 2: OCC gradient norms (only for non-detach conditions)."""
    non_detach = {c: d for c, d in results.items() if not d["occ_detach"]}
    if not non_detach:
        print("No non-detach conditions, skipping occ gradient norms plot")
        return

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 4.5), sharey=True)

    for i, (prefix, backbone_name) in enumerate(BACKBONE_PREFIXES.items()):
        ax = axes[i]
        for cond, data in non_detach.items():
            style = get_style(cond)
            blocks = extract_blocks(data["per_layer"], prefix)
            if not blocks:
                continue
            xs = [b[0] for b in blocks]
            ys = [b[1]["occ_grad_norm_mean"] for b in blocks]
            ax.plot(xs, ys, marker=style["marker"], ls=style["ls"],
                    color=style["color"], label=style["label"],
                    markersize=4, linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.85)

        ax.set_xlabel("Block Index")
        ax.set_ylabel("OCC Gradient L2 Norm" if i == 0 else "")
        ax.set_title(f"{backbone_name}")
        ax.set_yscale("log")
        ax.legend(loc="best", framealpha=0.9)

    fig.suptitle("OCC Gradient Norms per Block (Non-Detach Only)", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", y=1.02)
    plt.tight_layout()
    for ext in ("pdf", "png"):
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(output_dir, f"occ_gradient_norms.{ext}"), dpi=dpi)
    plt.close(fig)
    print("Saved: occ_gradient_norms.pdf/png")


def plot_gradient_amplification(results, output_dir, dpi):
    """Fig 3: Action gradient ratio (Full OCC / Detach) per backbone, comparing BN vs LN."""
    pairs = [
        ("full_occ_bn", "detach_bn", "BN"),
        ("full_occ_ln", "detach_ln", "LN"),
    ]
    available_pairs = [(f, d, l) for f, d, l in pairs if f in results and d in results]
    if not available_pairs:
        print("No full/detach pairs available, skipping amplification plot")
        return

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 4.5), sharey=True)
    colors_pair = {"BN": "#9C27B0", "LN": "#009688"}

    for i, (prefix, backbone_name) in enumerate(BACKBONE_PREFIXES.items()):
        ax = axes[i]
        for full_cond, detach_cond, norm_label in available_pairs:
            full_blocks = {b[0]: b[1] for b in extract_blocks(results[full_cond]["per_layer"], prefix)}
            detach_blocks = {b[0]: b[1] for b in extract_blocks(results[detach_cond]["per_layer"], prefix)}
            common = sorted(set(full_blocks) & set(detach_blocks))
            xs, ys = [], []
            for idx in common:
                f_val = full_blocks[idx]["action_grad_norm_mean"]
                d_val = detach_blocks[idx]["action_grad_norm_mean"]
                if f_val > 0 and d_val > 0:
                    xs.append(idx)
                    ys.append(f_val / d_val)
            ax.plot(xs, ys, "o-", color=colors_pair[norm_label],
                    label=f"{norm_label} (Full/Detach)", markersize=4, linewidth=1.5)

        ax.axhline(y=1, color="gray", linestyle="--", alpha=0.5, linewidth=1)
        ax.set_xlabel("Block Index")
        ax.set_ylabel("Gradient Ratio (Full OCC / Detach)" if i == 0 else "")
        ax.set_title(f"{backbone_name}")
        ax.set_yscale("log")
        ax.legend(loc="best", framealpha=0.9)

    fig.suptitle("Action Gradient Amplification by OCC Task", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", y=1.02)
    plt.tight_layout()
    for ext in ("pdf", "png"):
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(output_dir, f"gradient_amplification.{ext}"), dpi=dpi)
    plt.close(fig)
    print("Saved: gradient_amplification.pdf/png")


def plot_cosine_similarity_heatmap(results, output_dir, dpi):
    """Fig 4: Cosine similarity between action and occ gradients (non-detach conditions)."""
    non_detach = {c: d for c, d in results.items() if not d["occ_detach"]}
    if not non_detach:
        print("No non-detach conditions, skipping cosine similarity plot")
        return

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 4.5), sharey=True)

    for i, (prefix, backbone_name) in enumerate(BACKBONE_PREFIXES.items()):
        ax = axes[i]
        for cond, data in non_detach.items():
            style = get_style(cond)
            blocks = extract_blocks(data["per_layer"], prefix)
            xs, ys = [], []
            for idx, stats in blocks:
                if stats["cosine_sim_mean"] is not None:
                    xs.append(idx)
                    ys.append(stats["cosine_sim_mean"])
            if xs:
                ax.plot(xs, ys, marker=style["marker"], ls=style["ls"],
                        color=style["color"], label=style["label"],
                        markersize=4, linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.85)

        ax.axhline(y=0, color="red", linestyle="--", alpha=0.4, linewidth=1)
        ax.set_xlabel("Block Index")
        ax.set_ylabel("Cosine Similarity" if i == 0 else "")
        ax.set_title(f"{backbone_name}")
        ax.set_ylim(-1, 1)
        ax.legend(loc="best", framealpha=0.9)

    fig.suptitle("Action-OCC Gradient Cosine Similarity per Block", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", y=1.02)
    plt.tight_layout()
    for ext in ("pdf", "png"):
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(output_dir, f"cosine_similarity.{ext}"), dpi=dpi)
    plt.close(fig)
    print("Saved: cosine_similarity.pdf/png")


def plot_conflict_rate(results, output_dir, dpi):
    """Fig 5: Gradient conflict rate (non-detach conditions)."""
    non_detach = {c: d for c, d in results.items() if not d["occ_detach"]}
    if not non_detach:
        print("No non-detach conditions, skipping conflict rate plot")
        return

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 4.5), sharey=True)

    for i, (prefix, backbone_name) in enumerate(BACKBONE_PREFIXES.items()):
        ax = axes[i]
        n_conds = len(non_detach)
        bar_w = 0.8 / max(n_conds, 1)

        for j, (cond, data) in enumerate(non_detach.items()):
            style = get_style(cond)
            blocks = extract_blocks(data["per_layer"], prefix)
            xs, ys = [], []
            for idx, stats in blocks:
                if stats["conflict_rate"] is not None:
                    xs.append(idx)
                    ys.append(stats["conflict_rate"])
            offset = (j - (n_conds - 1) / 2) * bar_w
            if xs:
                ax.bar([x + offset for x in xs], ys, width=bar_w,
                       color=style["color"], label=style["label"], alpha=0.7)

        ax.set_xlabel("Block Index")
        ax.set_ylabel("Conflict Rate" if i == 0 else "")
        ax.set_title(f"{backbone_name}")
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.PercentFormatter(1.0))
        ax.legend(loc="best", framealpha=0.9)

    fig.suptitle("Gradient Conflict Rate per Block (cosine < 0)", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", y=1.02)
    plt.tight_layout()
    for ext in ("pdf", "png"):
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(output_dir, f"conflict_rate.{ext}"), dpi=dpi)
    plt.close(fig)
    print("Saved: conflict_rate.pdf/png")


def plot_bn_drift(results, output_dir, dpi):
    """Fig 6: BN running stats drift comparison (BN conditions only)."""
    bn_conds = {c: d for c, d in results.items()
                if d.get("occ_norm") == "bn" and d.get("bn_drift")}
    if not bn_conds:
        print("No BN conditions with drift data, skipping BN drift plot")
        return

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4.5))

    # Collect BN layer names
    all_bn_layers = set()
    for data in bn_conds.values():
        all_bn_layers.update(data["bn_drift"].keys())
    bn_layer_names = sorted(all_bn_layers)

    # Mean drift
    ax = axes[0]
    x = np.arange(len(bn_layer_names))
    bar_w = 0.8 / len(bn_conds)
    for j, (cond, data) in enumerate(bn_conds.items()):
        style = get_style(cond)
        ys = []
        for layer in bn_layer_names:
            if layer in data["bn_drift"]:
                ys.append(data["bn_drift"][layer]["mean_drift_l2"])
            else:
                ys.append(0)
        offset = (j - (len(bn_conds) - 1) / 2) * bar_w
        ax.bar(x + offset, ys, width=bar_w, color=style["color"],
               label=style["label"], alpha=0.8)
    ax.set_xlabel("BN Layer")
    ax.set_ylabel("L2 Norm of running_mean")
    ax.set_title("BN Running Mean Drift from Init")
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels([n.replace("decoder.", "d.") for n in bn_layer_names],
                       rotation=30, ha="right")
    ax.legend(framealpha=0.9)

    # Var drift
    ax = axes[1]
    for j, (cond, data) in enumerate(bn_conds.items()):
        style = get_style(cond)
        ys = []
        for layer in bn_layer_names:
            if layer in data["bn_drift"]:
                ys.append(data["bn_drift"][layer]["var_drift_from_one_l2"])
            else:
                ys.append(0)
        offset = (j - (len(bn_conds) - 1) / 2) * bar_w
        ax.bar(x + offset, ys, width=bar_w, color=style["color"],
               label=style["label"], alpha=0.8)
    ax.set_xlabel("BN Layer")
    ax.set_ylabel("L2 Norm of (running_var - 1)")
    ax.set_title("BN Running Var Drift from Init")
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels([n.replace("decoder.", "d.") for n in bn_layer_names],
                       rotation=30, ha="right")
    ax.legend(framealpha=0.9)

    fig.suptitle("BN Running Stats Drift: Full OCC vs Detach",
                 fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", y=1.02)
    plt.tight_layout()
    for ext in ("pdf", "png"):
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(output_dir, f"bn_drift.{ext}"), dpi=dpi)
    plt.close(fig)
    print("Saved: bn_drift.pdf/png")


def plot_combined_summary(results, output_dir, dpi):
    """Fig 7: Combined 2x3 summary figure for paper."""
    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 10))
    gs = GridSpec(2, 3, figure=fig, hspace=0.35, wspace=0.3)

    prefix = "featurizer"  # DINOv2 as main backbone for summary

    # (0,0) Action gradient norms
    ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
    for cond, data in results.items():
        style = get_style(cond)
        blocks = extract_blocks(data["per_layer"], prefix)
        if blocks:
            xs = [b[0] for b in blocks]
            ys = [b[1]["action_grad_norm_mean"] for b in blocks]
            ax.plot(xs, ys, marker=style["marker"], ls=style["ls"],
                    color=style["color"], label=style["label"],
                    markersize=3, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.85)
    ax.set_xlabel("DINOv2 Block")
    ax.set_ylabel("L2 Norm")
    ax.set_title("(a) Action Grad Norms")
    ax.set_yscale("log")
    ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc="best")

    # (0,1) OCC gradient norms (non-detach)
    ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
    for cond, data in results.items():
        if data["occ_detach"]:
            continue
        style = get_style(cond)
        blocks = extract_blocks(data["per_layer"], prefix)
        if blocks:
            xs = [b[0] for b in blocks]
            ys = [b[1]["occ_grad_norm_mean"] for b in blocks]
            ax.plot(xs, ys, marker=style["marker"], ls=style["ls"],
                    color=style["color"], label=style["label"],
                    markersize=3, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.85)
    ax.set_xlabel("DINOv2 Block")
    ax.set_ylabel("L2 Norm")
    ax.set_title("(b) OCC Grad Norms")
    ax.set_yscale("log")
    ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc="best")

    # (0,2) Gradient amplification ratio
    ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
    pairs = [("full_occ_bn", "detach_bn", "BN", "#9C27B0"),
             ("full_occ_ln", "detach_ln", "LN", "#009688")]
    for full_c, det_c, nl, clr in pairs:
        if full_c in results and det_c in results:
            fb = {b[0]: b[1] for b in extract_blocks(results[full_c]["per_layer"], prefix)}
            db = {b[0]: b[1] for b in extract_blocks(results[det_c]["per_layer"], prefix)}
            common = sorted(set(fb) & set(db))
            xs, ys = [], []
            for idx in common:
                fv = fb[idx]["action_grad_norm_mean"]
                dv = db[idx]["action_grad_norm_mean"]
                if fv > 0 and dv > 0:
                    xs.append(idx)
                    ys.append(fv / dv)
            ax.plot(xs, ys, "o-", color=clr, label=f"{nl}", markersize=3, linewidth=1.2)
    ax.axhline(y=1, color="gray", linestyle="--", alpha=0.5)
    ax.set_xlabel("DINOv2 Block")
    ax.set_ylabel("Ratio")
    ax.set_title("(c) Amplification (Full/Detach)")
    ax.set_yscale("log")
    ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc="best")

    # (1,0) Cosine similarity
    ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
    for cond, data in results.items():
        if data["occ_detach"]:
            continue
        style = get_style(cond)
        blocks = extract_blocks(data["per_layer"], prefix)
        xs, ys = [], []
        for idx, stats in blocks:
            if stats["cosine_sim_mean"] is not None:
                xs.append(idx)
                ys.append(stats["cosine_sim_mean"])
        if xs:
            ax.plot(xs, ys, marker=style["marker"], ls=style["ls"],
                    color=style["color"], label=style["label"],
                    markersize=3, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.85)
    ax.axhline(y=0, color="red", linestyle="--", alpha=0.4)
    ax.set_xlabel("DINOv2 Block")
    ax.set_ylabel("Cosine Sim")
    ax.set_title("(d) Action-OCC Cosine Similarity")
    ax.set_ylim(-1, 1)
    ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc="best")

    # (1,1) Conflict rate
    ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
    non_detach = {c: d for c, d in results.items() if not d["occ_detach"]}
    n_conds = len(non_detach)
    bar_w = 0.8 / max(n_conds, 1)
    for j, (cond, data) in enumerate(non_detach.items()):
        style = get_style(cond)
        blocks = extract_blocks(data["per_layer"], prefix)
        xs, ys = [], []
        for idx, stats in blocks:
            if stats["conflict_rate"] is not None:
                xs.append(idx)
                ys.append(stats["conflict_rate"])
        offset = (j - (n_conds - 1) / 2) * bar_w
        if xs:
            ax.bar([x + offset for x in xs], ys, width=bar_w,
                   color=style["color"], label=style["label"], alpha=0.7)
    ax.set_xlabel("DINOv2 Block")
    ax.set_ylabel("Conflict Rate")
    ax.set_title("(e) Gradient Conflict Rate")
    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.PercentFormatter(1.0))
    ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc="best")

    # (1,2) BN drift
    ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
    bn_conds = {c: d for c, d in results.items()
                if d.get("occ_norm") == "bn" and d.get("bn_drift")}
    if bn_conds:
        all_bn = set()
        for d in bn_conds.values():
            all_bn.update(d["bn_drift"].keys())
        bn_names = sorted(all_bn)
        x = np.arange(len(bn_names))
        bw = 0.8 / len(bn_conds)
        for j, (cond, data) in enumerate(bn_conds.items()):
            style = get_style(cond)
            ys = [data["bn_drift"].get(n, {}).get("mean_drift_l2", 0) for n in bn_names]
            offset = (j - (len(bn_conds) - 1) / 2) * bw
            ax.bar(x + offset, ys, width=bw, color=style["color"],
                   label=style["label"], alpha=0.8)
        ax.set_xticks(x)
        ax.set_xticklabels([n.split(".")[-1] for n in bn_names], rotation=30, ha="right")
        ax.legend(fontsize=7)
    else:
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No BN data", transform=ax.transAxes,
                ha="center", va="center", fontsize=14, color="gray")
    ax.set_xlabel("BN Layer")
    ax.set_ylabel("Mean Drift L2")
    ax.set_title("(f) BN Running Stats Drift")

    fig.suptitle("Same-Seed Gradient Analysis: 4-Condition Comparison (DINOv2)",
                 fontsize=14, fontweight="bold", y=0.98)
    for ext in ("pdf", "png"):
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(output_dir, f"gradient_summary.{ext}"), dpi=dpi)
    plt.close(fig)
    print("Saved: gradient_summary.pdf/png")


def print_summary_table(results):
    """Print markdown-style summary table."""
    print("\n## Summary Table\n")
    print("| Condition | Avg Act Loss | Avg OCC Loss | Mean Act Grad (DINOv2) | Mean Act Grad (SigLIP) |")
    print("|-----------|-------------|-------------|----------------------|----------------------|")
    for cond, data in results.items():
        dino_blocks = extract_blocks(data["per_layer"], "featurizer")
        siglip_blocks = extract_blocks(data["per_layer"], "fused_featurizer")
        dino_mean = np.mean([b[1]["action_grad_norm_mean"] for b in dino_blocks]) if dino_blocks else 0
        siglip_mean = np.mean([b[1]["action_grad_norm_mean"] for b in siglip_blocks]) if siglip_blocks else 0
        label = CONDITION_STYLES.get(cond, {}).get("label", cond)
        print(f"| {label} | {data['avg_action_loss']:.4f} | {data['avg_occ_loss']:.4f} | "
              f"{dino_mean:.6f} | {siglip_mean:.6f} |")

    # Amplification ratios
    pairs = [("full_occ_bn", "detach_bn", "BN"), ("full_occ_ln", "detach_ln", "LN")]
    available = [(f, d, l) for f, d, l in pairs if f in results and d in results]
    if available:
        print("\n## Gradient Amplification (Full OCC / Detach)\n")
        print("| Norm | Backbone | Mean Ratio | Median Ratio | Range |")
        print("|------|----------|-----------|-------------|-------|")
        for full_c, det_c, nl in available:
            for prefix, bname in BACKBONE_PREFIXES.items():
                fb = {b[0]: b[1] for b in extract_blocks(results[full_c]["per_layer"], prefix)}

def main():

"""
4-condition same-seed gradient comparison plots for OccSafe-VLA.

Reads JSON outputs from same_seed_gradient_analysis.py and produces
publication-quality comparison figures.

Usage:
  python plot_gradient_comparison.py \
    --results_dir /root/occsafe_vla/analysis/same_seed_results \
    --output_dir /root/occsafe_vla/analysis/same_seed_results/figures

  # Or specify individual files:
  python plot_gradient_comparison.py \
    --files full_occ_bn_gradient_stats.json detach_bn_gradient_stats.json \
            full_occ_ln_gradient_stats.json detach_ln_gradient_stats.json \
    --output_dir ./figures

Env: conda activate occsafe
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.gridspec import GridSpec
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker


CONDITION_STYLES = {
    "full_occ_bn":  {"color": "#2196F3", "marker": "o", "ls": "-",  "label": "Full OCC + BN"},
    "detach_bn":    {"color": "#F44336", "marker": "s", "ls": "--", "label": "Detach + BN"},
    "full_occ_ln":  {"color": "#4CAF50", "marker": "^", "ls": "-",  "label": "Full OCC + LN"},
    "detach_ln":    {"color": "#FF9800", "marker": "D", "ls": "--", "label": "Detach + LN"},
}

BACKBONE_PREFIXES = {
    "featurizer": "DINOv2",
    "fused_featurizer": "SigLIP",
}


def parse_args():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--results_dir", type=str, default=None,
                        help="Directory with *_gradient_stats.json files")
    parser.add_argument("--files", nargs="+", default=None,
                        help="Explicit list of JSON stat files")
    parser.add_argument("--output_dir", type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--dpi", type=int, default=300)
    return parser.parse_args()


def load_results(args):
    if args.files:
        paths = [Path(f) for f in args.files]
    elif args.results_dir:
        paths = sorted(Path(args.results_dir).glob("*_gradient_stats.json"))
    else:
        raise ValueError("Must specify --results_dir or --files")

    results = {}
    for p in paths:
        with open(p) as f:
            data = json.load(f)
        cond = data["condition"]
        results[cond] = data
        print(f"Loaded {cond}: {p.name}")
    return results


def extract_blocks(per_layer, prefix):
    blocks = []
    for layer_name, stats in per_layer.items():
        if layer_name.startswith(f"{prefix}.blocks."):
            idx = int(layer_name.split(".")[-1])
            blocks.append((idx, stats))
    blocks.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    return blocks


def setup_style():
    plt.rcParams.update({
        "font.family": "serif",
        "font.serif": ["Times New Roman", "DejaVu Serif"],
        "font.size": 10,
        "axes.labelsize": 11,
        "axes.titlesize": 12,
        "legend.fontsize": 9,
        "xtick.labelsize": 9,
        "ytick.labelsize": 9,
        "figure.dpi": 150,
        "savefig.dpi": 300,
        "savefig.bbox": "tight",
        "axes.grid": True,
        "grid.alpha": 0.3,
        "grid.linewidth": 0.5,
    })


def get_style(cond):
    if cond in CONDITION_STYLES:
        return CONDITION_STYLES[cond]
    return {"color": "gray", "marker": "x", "ls": "-", "label": cond}


def plot_action_gradient_norms(results, output_dir, dpi):
    """Fig 1: Per-layer action gradient norms across 4 conditions, split by backbone."""
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 4.5), sharey=True)

    for i, (prefix, backbone_name) in enumerate(BACKBONE_PREFIXES.items()):
        ax = axes[i]
        for cond, data in results.items():
            style = get_style(cond)
            blocks = extract_blocks(data["per_layer"], prefix)
            if not blocks:
                continue
            xs = [b[0] for b in blocks]
            ys = [b[1]["action_grad_norm_mean"] for b in blocks]
            ax.plot(xs, ys, marker=style["marker"], ls=style["ls"],
                    color=style["color"], label=style["label"],
                    markersize=4, linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.85)

        ax.set_xlabel("Block Index")
        ax.set_ylabel("Action Gradient L2 Norm" if i == 0 else "")
        ax.set_title(f"{backbone_name}")
        ax.set_yscale("log")
        ax.legend(loc="best", framealpha=0.9)

    fig.suptitle("Action Gradient Norms per Block (Same Seed)", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", y=1.02)
    plt.tight_layout()
    for ext in ("pdf", "png"):
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(output_dir, f"action_gradient_norms.{ext}"), dpi=dpi)
    plt.close(fig)
    print("Saved: action_gradient_norms.pdf/png")


def plot_occ_gradient_norms(results, output_dir, dpi):
    """Fig 2: OCC gradient norms (only for non-detach conditions)."""
    non_detach = {c: d for c, d in results.items() if not d["occ_detach"]}
    if not non_detach:
        print("No non-detach conditions, skipping occ gradient norms plot")
        return

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 4.5), sharey=True)

    for i, (prefix, backbone_name) in enumerate(BACKBONE_PREFIXES.items()):
        ax = axes[i]
        for cond, data in non_detach.items():
            style = get_style(cond)
            blocks = extract_blocks(data["per_layer"], prefix)
            if not blocks:
                continue
            xs = [b[0] for b in blocks]
            ys = [b[1]["occ_grad_norm_mean"] for b in blocks]
            ax.plot(xs, ys, marker=style["marker"], ls=style["ls"],
                    color=style["color"], label=style["label"],
                    markersize=4, linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.85)

        ax.set_xlabel("Block Index")
        ax.set_ylabel("OCC Gradient L2 Norm" if i == 0 else "")
        ax.set_title(f"{backbone_name}")
        ax.set_yscale("log")
        ax.legend(loc="best", framealpha=0.9)

    fig.suptitle("OCC Gradient Norms per Block (Non-Detach Only)", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", y=1.02)
    plt.tight_layout()
    for ext in ("pdf", "png"):
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(output_dir, f"occ_gradient_norms.{ext}"), dpi=dpi)
    plt.close(fig)
    print("Saved: occ_gradient_norms.pdf/png")


def plot_gradient_amplification(results, output_dir, dpi):
    """Fig 3: Action gradient ratio (Full OCC / Detach) per backbone, comparing BN vs LN."""
    pairs = [
        ("full_occ_bn", "detach_bn", "BN"),
        ("full_occ_ln", "detach_ln", "LN"),
    ]
    available_pairs = [(f, d, l) for f, d, l in pairs if f in results and d in results]
    if not available_pairs:
        print("No full/detach pairs available, skipping amplification plot")
        return

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 4.5), sharey=True)
    colors_pair = {"BN": "#9C27B0", "LN": "#009688"}

    for i, (prefix, backbone_name) in enumerate(BACKBONE_PREFIXES.items()):
        ax = axes[i]
        for full_cond, detach_cond, norm_label in available_pairs:
            full_blocks = {b[0]: b[1] for b in extract_blocks(results[full_cond]["per_layer"], prefix)}
            detach_blocks = {b[0]: b[1] for b in extract_blocks(results[detach_cond]["per_layer"], prefix)}
            common = sorted(set(full_blocks) & set(detach_blocks))
            xs, ys = [], []
            for idx in common:
                f_val = full_blocks[idx]["action_grad_norm_mean"]
                d_val = detach_blocks[idx]["action_grad_norm_mean"]
                if f_val > 0 and d_val > 0:
                    xs.append(idx)
                    ys.append(f_val / d_val)
            ax.plot(xs, ys, "o-", color=colors_pair[norm_label],
                    label=f"{norm_label} (Full/Detach)", markersize=4, linewidth=1.5)

        ax.axhline(y=1, color="gray", linestyle="--", alpha=0.5, linewidth=1)
        ax.set_xlabel("Block Index")
        ax.set_ylabel("Gradient Ratio (Full OCC / Detach)" if i == 0 else "")
        ax.set_title(f"{backbone_name}")
        ax.set_yscale("log")
        ax.legend(loc="best", framealpha=0.9)

    fig.suptitle("Action Gradient Amplification by OCC Task", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", y=1.02)
    plt.tight_layout()
    for ext in ("pdf", "png"):
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(output_dir, f"gradient_amplification.{ext}"), dpi=dpi)
    plt.close(fig)
    print("Saved: gradient_amplification.pdf/png")


def plot_cosine_similarity_heatmap(results, output_dir, dpi):
    """Fig 4: Cosine similarity between action and occ gradients (non-detach conditions)."""
    non_detach = {c: d for c, d in results.items() if not d["occ_detach"]}
    if not non_detach:
        print("No non-detach conditions, skipping cosine similarity plot")
        return

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 4.5), sharey=True)

    for i, (prefix, backbone_name) in enumerate(BACKBONE_PREFIXES.items()):
        ax = axes[i]
        for cond, data in non_detach.items():
            style = get_style(cond)
            blocks = extract_blocks(data["per_layer"], prefix)
            xs, ys = [], []
            for idx, stats in blocks:
                if stats["cosine_sim_mean"] is not None:
                    xs.append(idx)
                    ys.append(stats["cosine_sim_mean"])
            if xs:

        ax.set_xlabel("Block Index")
        ax.set_ylabel("Cosine Similarity" if i == 0 else "")
        ax.set_title(f"{backbone_name}")
        ax.set_ylim(-1, 1)
        ax.legend(loc="best", framealpha=0.9)

    fig.suptitle("Action-OCC Gradient Cosine Similarity per Block", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", y=1.02)
    plt.tight_layout()
    for ext in ("pdf", "png"):
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(output_dir, f"cosine_similarity.{ext}"), dpi=dpi)
    plt.close(fig)
    print("Saved: cosine_similarity.pdf/png")


def plot_conflict_rate(results, output_dir, dpi):
    """Fig 5: Gradient conflict rate (non-detach conditions)."""
    non_detach = {c: d for c, d in results.items() if not d["occ_detach"]}
    if not non_detach:
        print("No non-detach conditions, skipping conflict rate plot")
        return

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 4.5), sharey=True)

    for i, (prefix, backbone_name) in enumerate(BACKBONE_PREFIXES.items()):
        ax = axes[i]

            style = get_style(cond)

            xs, ys = [], []

                       color=style["color"], label=style["label"], alpha=0.7)

        ax.set_xlabel("Block Index")
        ax.set_ylabel("Conflict Rate" if i == 0 else "")
        ax.set_title(f"{backbone_name}")
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.PercentFormatter(1.0))
        ax.legend(loc="best", framealpha=0.9)

def plot_combined_summary(results, output_dir, dpi):

    print("| Condition | Avg Act Loss | Avg OCC Loss | Mean Act Grad (DINOv2) | Mean Act Grad (SigLIP) |")
    print("|-----------|-------------|-------------|----------------------|----------------------|")
    for cond, data in results.items():

        siglip_blocks = extract_blocks(data["per_layer"], "fused_featurizer")

        siglip_mean = np.mean([b[1]["action_grad_norm_mean"] for b in siglip_blocks]) if siglip_blocks else 0

    pairs = [("full_occ_bn", "detach_bn", "BN"), ("full_occ_ln", "detach_ln", "LN")]
    available = [(f, d, l) for f, d, l in pairs if f in results and d in results]
    if available:
        print("\n## Gradient Amplification (Full OCC / Detach)\n")
        print("| Norm | Backbone | Mean Ratio | Median Ratio | Range |")
        print("|------|----------|-----------|-------------|-------|")
        for full_c, det_c, nl in available:
            for prefix, bname in BACKBONE_PREFIXES.items():

                for idx in sorted(set(fb) & set(db)):

                    if fv > 0 and dv > 0:

    setup_style()

    results = load_results(args)
    if not results:

        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"\nLoaded {len(results)} conditions: {list(results.keys())}")

    plot_action_gradient_norms(results, args.output_dir, args.dpi)
    plot_occ_gradient_norms(results, args.output_dir, args.dpi)
    plot_gradient_amplification(results, args.output_dir, args.dpi)
    plot_cosine_similarity_heatmap(results, args.output_dir, args.dpi)
    plot_conflict_rate(results, args.output_dir, args.dpi)
    plot_bn_drift(results, args.output_dir, args.dpi)
    plot_combined_summary(results, args.output_dir, args.dpi)

    print_summary_table(results)

    print(f"\nAll figures saved to {args.output_dir}")

    main()
